newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Woman fails to see Rabin's killer on "Love Day".
newsitem.headline: Woman fails to see Rabin's killer on "Love Day".

text.p: A young Israeli woman pined outside a desert prison on Monday for Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin's assassin Yigal Amir on the Jewish "holiday of love".
Authorities at Beersheba prison in southern Israel had no intention of playing matchmaker.

"There's something about him," the Russian-born 23-year-old, who gave her name only as Tatiana, told Israel Radio on Tu B'av, the 15th day of the Hebrew month of Av when religious Jews traditionally seek a mate.
"I want him to feel good and feel that today is the day of love," she said.

She was escorted by Avigdor Eskin, an ultranationalist convicted in May of violating the Prevention of Terrorism Act by putting a curse on Rabin a month before Amir killed him for making peace with Arabs.
"Please, this girl only wants a form and to sign up to meet him," Eskin said after jailers kept her locked out. Eskin is free on bail while he appeals a four-month prison sentence.

"Why are Arab prisoners allowed to meet their relatives and she is not?" Eskin asked at the gate in broadcast remarks. "We will press on until Yigal, like every Arab convicted of murdering dozens of Jews, can meet his intended."
Amir is in solitary confinement and serving a life term for the November 1995 assassination.
Last year, news that several teenage girls at a religious high school had formed a Yigal Amir fan club shocked many Israelis.
